provenance.sourcePrompt:
Left-center-right triptych time-echo split effect over backgroundVideo. Default state is full-width single video. Five times the frame splits into three columns. Key fix: all three columns AND both divider bars must disappear at the EXACT SAME FRAME — zero staggering on exit
SPLIT EVENT TIMING (5 events × 2.0s each)
Event 1: 2.0s – 4.0s
Event 2: 7.0s – 9.0s
Event 3: 13.0s – 15.0s
Event 4: 19.0s – 21.0s
Event 5: 25.5s – 27.5s
ENTER phase (0.15s, easeOut)
A single wrapper div (#splitLayer) containing all three column-videos and both bars fades in: opacity 0 → 1 over 0.15s
Simultaneously: left bar slides from translateX(-100%) to translateX(0); right bar slides from translateX(+100%) to translateX(0). Both bars use the same 0.15s easeOut timing
The full-width single backgroundVideo fades out: opacity 1 → 0 over 0.15s
HOLD phase (1.70s)
#splitLayer fully visible (opacity 1). Three column videos showing the time-echo
Left column (0–33.33% width): clip of backgroundVideo at currentTime
Center column (33.33–66.67%): same src, currentTime + 0.3s
Right column (66.67–100%): same src, currentTime + 0.6s
Sync on every requestAnimationFrame: centerVid.currentTime = leftVid.currentTime + 0.3; rightVid.currentTime = leftVid.currentTime + 0.6. Clamp to duration
Both bar dividers fully visible at their resting positions (33.33% and 66.67%)
EXIT phase (0.15s, easeIn) — CRITICAL REQUIREMENT
The ENTIRE #splitLayer (all three column-videos + both bars together) fades out as ONE unit: opacity 1 → 0 over 0.15s using a single CSS transition on #splitLayer itself
DO NOT animate individual columns or bars separately on exit. DO NOT stagger. The opacity transition is on the parent wrapper only
Simultaneously: left bar translateX(0) → translateX(-100%); right bar translateX(0) → translateX(+100%). Both at same 0.15s easeIn
The full-width single backgroundVideo fades back in: opacity 0 → 1 over 0.15s
Result: all three split columns vanish at the exact same frame. No column lingers after another disappears
BETWEEN EVENTS
#splitLayer: display:none (or visibility:hidden + opacity:0). No visual artifacts
Full-width backgroundVideo: visible, opacity 1, playing normally
DIVIDER BARS
Two divs inside #splitLayer, each 10px wide, 100% height, background #000000
box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)
Left bar: positioned at left:33.33%. Right bar: left:66.67%
Both are children of #splitLayer so they inherit the parent opacity on exit
COLUMN CLIPPING
Three wrapper divs inside #splitLayer, each position:absolute, overflow:hidden
Left: left:0, width:33.33%
Center: left:33.33%, width:33.34%
Right: left:66.67%, width:33.33%
Each wrapper contains a video element that is 100vw wide, positioned so the correct third is visible (left:-0%, left:-100%, left:-200% respectively — or use object-fit + clip-path)
All video elements muted
No text, no captions, no UI chrome, no effects. Pure geometric temporal split on a serene matte pastel landscape dreamscape
